CheckTitle: EC2 instances with open ingress MongoDB ports to the internet
Description: EC2 instances found to allow ingress from the internet to MongoDB ports (TCP: 27017, 27018).
Risk: These ports handle MongoDB database connections and replica set communications. Attackers can exploit unprotected instances to ransom databases, dump sensitive collections, or inject malicious documents into production databases.

Recommendation.Text: Ensure access to ports from the internet is limited for EC2 instances. Apply the concept of Least Privilege and limit traffic to sensitive resources.
